name: Tripleize Co. Ltd.
summary: Tripleize Co., Ltd. is engaged in systems integration and its own AI platform services through AI Solutions and GPU Server segments. AI Solutions covers a stock-type AI platform business and system development using AI technology, while the GPU Server segment develops, sells and operates high-performance PCs, along with data center infrastructure. Satoru Fukuhara founded it in 2008, and it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
